messages:
Maria R: Quick thread — postmortem follow-up from the missing spans + aggregation drift incident. We need clear owners for remediation items and a short timeline. Can folks volunteer? Thanks.
Aj Patel: I can take ownership of root-cause triage for the ETL lag. Will check job history and offsets. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sanjay K: I'll own the backfill/repair plan for missing spans and coordinate with infra for capacity. Need 2 GPUs for a couple hours. ETA Wed EOD.
Ops Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3142 | Severity: P2 | Autocreated runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/etl-backfill
Tess L: I'll validate aggregate joins and add data-correctness tests to CI. ETA Tue morning.
Leo M: I'll add an alert for aggregator drift (>=0.5% diff over 5m) and a dashboard tile. ETA today.
Irene: I'll be CS liaison, summarize customer impact + notify affected accounts by EOD.
Maria R: Action items summary: 1) Triage ETL offsets — Aj 2) Backfill plan + run — Sanjay 3) Aggregation tests — Tess 4) Alert + dash — Leo 5) Customer comms — Irene. Please confirm ETAs in thread.
Aj Patel: Confirmed: triage done by 2026-04-21 18:00 UTC, posting findings here.
Sanjay K: Backfill plan: run dry-run on staging, then run `./etl backfill --start=2026-04-15 --end=2026-04-20 --shard=all` during low traffic window. Logging snippet I saw earlier:
```
[WARN] commit lag on consumer group analytics-etl: lag=2300000
[ERROR] failed batch write: timeout after 30s
```
Need infra approval for maintenance window.
Tess L: Adding tests: 1) join cardinality checks 2) null-rate sanity 3) rolling-aggregates vs raw counts. PR will be up today.
Leo M: Alert done: `agg_drift_ratio > 0.005 for 5m` -> notify #incidents + oncall. Dashboard tile linked: /dashboards/agg-health
Irene: Drafted customer note, posting to #customer-comm in 1h for review.
Maria R: Ok — I'll compile weekly status for postmortem doc and mark owners in the action tracker. Reminder: set recurring check for this pattern — seems periodic. Any volunteers to run a small analysis for recurrence window?
Aj Patel: I'll run an analysis to check recurrence windows and post results in 24h.
Sanjay K: One more ask — can infra set a temp autoscale policy for ETL backfills? @ops-infra
Ops Bot: @ops-infra paged for approval (ticket INFRA-5420).
Maria R: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem with owner assignments + timelines. :thumbsup:
